card.name: Infusion rate and dose-setting wording
card.fires_on: Words in dosing directions for IV infusions, such as "rate" after "infusion", "dose" in titration text, or the end of a rate unit like mg/hour. It also fires on the space just before a starting rate.

modes.label: Infusion rate word
modes.description: The word rate or dose right after infusion or increase, in titration instructions.
modes.example: increase the infusion<< rate>> by 2.5 mg/hr every

modes.label: Rate units
modes.description: The end of a per-hour unit in infusion tables or rate lists.

modes.label: Start of a starting rate
modes.description: The space or gap just before the initial infusion rate figure.
modes.example: initiate intravenous infusion of Cleviprex at<< >>1- 2 mg/hour.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like maximum and max, and away from words about annual or monthly rates.
card.plain: It lights up in IV infusion directions where a rate or dose is being set or adjusted.
